title: Sync Metadata
description: M10.0 per-device sync state: which artifacts have been pushed or pulled, when, and how many bytes moved. Stored at $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/agent-continuity/sync-metadata.json (defaults to ~/.config/...). Single file per device; written atomically (tmp + os.replace) on each sync operation. Doctor (M10.2) reads this to surface freshness; an artifact missing from `artifacts` means 'never synced from this device.'

device_id.description: Owner of this metadata file; must match local device-identity.json. Doctor verifies the match in M10.2.

artifacts.description: Per-artifact-name sync state. M10.0: 'decisions' only. M10.1 adds 'project-registry'. M10.2 adds 'context-pinned'. The object's additionalProperties is the strict ArtifactSyncState shape — new artifact names don't require a schema bump, but each entry must match the shape.

last_push_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC of last successful push from this device. null = never pushed.

last_pull_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC of last successful pull to this device. null = never pulled.

last_push_bytes.description: Size of the on-VM artifact after the last successful push. Informational.

last_pull_bytes.description: Size of the on-local artifact after the last successful pull. Informational.
